name: VR-301 UI audit scope
description: UI audit tasks should document active React entrypoint, active stylesheet, map controls, search states, route panels, overlay states, pain points, and phased recommendations without rewriting product components.

name: VeloRail design system v1
description: Use design tokens in src/styles/design-system.css and shared primitives under src/components/ui for route controls, chips, surfaces, buttons, and compact operational UI states.

name: Compact scenario-grouped map layer panel
description: VR-303 replaced the flat overlay chip row with a design-system layer panel grouped as Current, Future, Visionary, and Nationalized. State still comes from useMapOverlayStore, the registry now exposes group and legend metadata, and the legend only lists currently visible overlays.

name: Route results panel hierarchy
description: VR-304 separates route result loading, error, empty, option-list, and selected-detail states. Route cards display duration, mode sequence, distance, transfer count, bike safety, and future availability from existing Route fields; selected details show leg endpoints, line chips, stop counts, wait/delay badges, and bike safety without changing routing logic.
